title: maxillaria paleata
intro: Maxillaria paleata, commonly known as the pale mask orchid, is a type of orchid species in the family Orchidaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory health. The therapeutic actions of Maxillaria paleata may include anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties, helping to relieve symptoms of bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
